item.title: Tustumena replacement project out to bid, new ferry to sail in 2029
item.description: The state's project notice calls for the new mainliner ferry to be completed by the beginning of 2029 with an estimated price tag of more than $300 million.

item.title: It could be weeks before Juneau residents can recycle again
item.description: The city recycling center remains closed due to multiple issues with its baler. City officials say it could take weeks before it's repaired.

item.title: A $50M literacy grant is helping Alaska schools, but some districts say it’s tough to access funds
